# NLP501-bench v1 results (generated by `python -m app.eval.benchmark report`; do not edit by hand)

## External validity: Djinni Aggregate Human Gold (production, 8 real JDs)

| System | nDCG@10 [95% CI] | P@5 both humans ≥2 | τ-b | Δ vs B0 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| B0 BM25 | 0.422 [0.320, 0.515] | 0.325 | 0.170 | — |
| B1 dense | 0.464 [0.399, 0.540] | 0.475 | 0.172 | +0.042 |
| B2 hybrid | 0.482 [0.399, 0.572] | 0.525 | 0.192 | +0.060 |
| B3 8-axis ⊕ CE [hybrid] | **0.636 [0.554, 0.725]** | **0.650** | **0.400** | **+0.214** |
| P6 | pending (Gemini HTTP 503 before first completed JD) | — | — | — |

This real-data table uses independent Human Gold (Vũ–Đán κw=0.696), ignores unjudged profiles rather than treating
them as zero, and was not used for tuning. Full sensitivity analysis: `DJINNI_PRODUCTION_RESULTS.md`.

Protocol: docs/BENCHMARK.md. Manifest: data/eval/benchmark_v1.json (all inputs match). Each JD ranks the CVs labelled for it; mean over JDs with a 95% bootstrap CI; paired one-sided bootstrap p for “first > second”. LLM: Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5; PYTHONHASHSEED=0.
